A '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="DL" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was fighting in the conflict alongside their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], the [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Klossi Anno]]. When [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;an order to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;was initiated, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] turned on their Jedi Generals, considering them [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to the Republic. The Master was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], though their sacrifice allowed Anno to escape. Anno later met with other fugitive Jedi&mdash;including the Jedi Master [[Roan Shryne]]&mdash;to whom she gave her Jedi Master's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="DL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Master was mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DL" />
